brands.evidence: Yes, Monzo is a real, fully licensed UK bank, not just an app.
Wise or Revolut's UK entity, which operate under Electronic Money Institution (EMI) rules and rely on "safeguarding" rather than FSCS protection.

client_claims.text: Monzo holds a full UK banking licence. It is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) and regulated by both the FCA and the PRA.
Your eligible deposits up to £85,000 are covered by the FSCS.
client_claims.note: Fact states FSCS protection is up to £120,000 per person, not £85,000.

client_claims.text: It provides full UK current accounts with your own sort code and account number; you can receive salary, set up Direct Debits and standing orders, apply for overdrafts and loans, and earn interest on savings.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover these features in general.

client_claims.text: Monzo is a digital-only bank with no branches, managed via its smartphone app.
Monzo launched in 2015, originally called Mondo, starting as a prepaid card while awaiting regulatory approval.
Monzo was granted a full UK banking licence in April 2017.
